translations.web: A man who is tormented by life blood will be a fugitive until death; no one will support him.
translations.bsb: A man burdened by bloodguilt will flee into the Pit; let no one support him.
translations.kjv: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay
translations.asv: A man that is laden with the blood of any person Shall flee unto the pit; let no man stay him.
